name: Fever Shade
desc: Dead warmth fills the cold air around it.
message: The fever became your last dream.

name: Endless Swimmer
desc: Swims slow circles in the shallows, never tiring.

name: Tattered Sneakers
desc:
Must have been fast once.
Provides +1 🍀 Luck.

name: Filament Cap
desc:
A hollowed-out bulb that flickers with static electricity.
Provides +1 🧠 Intellect.

name: Office Shirt
desc:
The ink stains tell a story of interrupted work.
Provides +1 ⚔️ Attack and +1 🧠 Intellect.
message: Dressed for a meeting that won't happen.

name: Workbench Boxer
desc:
A heavy metal tool turned into a fist.
Provides +2 ⚔️ Attack for -1 🟢 Energy.

name: Cargo Shorts
desc:
Pockets full of lint and lost hopes.
Provides +1 ❤️ Health and +1 🟢 Energy.

name: Crystal Beaker
desc:
Bubbles with a liquid that defies gravity.
Provides +1 🧠 Intellect and +1 🔵 Mana.

name: Iridescent Leotard
desc:
Moves as if floating on an unseen wind.
Provides +1 🟢 Energy and +1 🔵 Mana.

name: Sharp Bamboo
desc:
Grows faster than you can bleed.
Provides +2 ⚔️ Attack for -1 🧠 Intellect.

name: Mariner's Ear
desc:
Allows you to hear the heartbeat of the river.
Provides +1 🍀 Luck and +1 🔵 Mana.

name: Safety Vest
desc:
Supposed to keep you afloat in the dark waters.
Provides +2 ❤️ Health.

name: Rusty Chassis
desc:
A twisted remnant of a consumerist era.
Provides +2 ⚔️ Attack for -1 🍀 Luck.

name: Moonless Watch
desc:
Darkness thick enough to press behind the eyes.
Bad dreams follow you out.
message: You slept. The nightmares did not.

name: Widow's Shroud
desc:
A grief too heavy to wear, but you wear it anyway.
Unique power TBD.

name: Widow's Heel
desc:
She walked in these once.
Unique power TBD.

name: Grave-Marker Pin
desc:
A cold, black spade that pins your thoughts to the earth.
Provides +3 🔵 Mana.

name: Exposed Ribcage
desc:
The bone is cold, but the protection it offers is absolute.
Provides +3 🔰 Defence for -2 💔 Health.

name: Infected Needle
desc:
One prick is all it takes to share the rot.
Provides +3 ⚔️ Attack for -1 🧠 Intellect.

name: Bionic Piston
desc:
Pumps with a rhythmic, mechanical hatred.
Provides +3 🟢 Energy for -1 💔 Health.

name: Buoyant Ring
desc:
Keeps you from sinking into the darker thoughts.
Provides +1 ❤️ Health and +1 🍀 Luck.

name: Scuba Mask
desc:
Glass is fogged with ancient, trapped air.
Provides +1 🧠 Intellect and +1 🔵 Mana.

name: Sunken Skis
desc:
Useless for snow, but they provide strange stability.
Provides +1 🟢 Energy and +1 🍀 Luck.

name: Reinforced Rod
desc:
Strong enough to pull secrets from the silt.
Provides +1 ⚔️ Attack and +1 🍀 Luck.

name: Heavy Anchor
desc:
Solid iron that demands you stay exactly where you are.
Provides +2 ⚔️ Attack and +1 🔰 Defence for -1 🟢 Energy.
